notes.title: PATCH 1.3
notes.content:
- Achievement bug is fixed. If you can't get all achievements at once, try to get in a map and back to menu. The game tries to register all achievements on the menu but sometimes Steam can't register all at once.

- Small visual upgrade to menu and maps.

- New Steam library artworks.


You can always join us on Quicksave discord server: https://discord.gg/Er3dXNj

notes.title: PATCH 1.2
notes.content:
- Map Level achievements registers are fixed.

- Blank screen when returning to main menu is fixed.





"Please share the problems you  encounter in the community hub on Steam"



* Patch will be released today. Thank you for your patience.
